notes.title: Version Update - Black Sails
notes.content:
We just released a patch (which will be automatically download when Steam is started - unless you have that feature turned off) which contains the following fix(es):

- Fixed a problem with the mouse cursor not being responsive at not native resolutions < 1920x1080
